content.text: {"explanations":[{"signal_id":"6fae7309-2403-4758-8f14-7fbe8d388603","explanation":"Total leverage of {{fact:c601b895-84de-4c17-924d-3a457d9892bf}} is above the {{fact:4836287c-1df0-4096-9e1b-02a7553358db}} maximum, so headroom is negative at {{fact:63375695-c4ab-42c7-83aa-4c5a3acfd506}}. On these figures the covenant appears to be breached, not just tight. Debt is high relative to earnings, and this coincides with shrinking liquidity headroom on the current ratio."},{"signal_id":"b689425e-4663-41b4-8f48-83d4b56cc77d","explanation":"The current ratio of {{fact:ca57b164-5c32-4cfe-a039-7f0017a2a32a}} still clears the {{fact:7c9ed9aa-c5b8-49ec-90d5-6d3d9e2f105b}} minimum, but with only {{fact:f34ba902-b8c0-40ad-81a1-6424bca6a595}} headroom.
